label: Rectangular room, EPFL (Lausanne)
note: the record does not name the room; the guidelines give 3.0 x 6.6 x 3.53 m, the ICASSP 2018 paper about 3 x 5.6 x 3.53 m, so no volume is given; one loudspeaker at (0.64, 4.21, 0.11) m; 132 microphones in 12 groups of 11 (mic1 to mic132, positions from position_132mic.mat); IRs computed by inverse FFT of the published transfer functions (7 s at 4 kHz, content to 2 kHz, bins up to 10 Hz zeroed), analysed over the first 3 s because the end of the file holds the wrapped decay; the levels are pressure per unit loudspeaker membrane velocity (Pa s/m), not comparable with other datasets. The authors state no reverberation time (the paper calls the room lightly damped). RIRDB's 3.6 s is a T20 from the 28 IRs whose mid-band decay spans 35 dB; in the other 104 the decay meets the transfer functions' noise floor about 30 dB down, so their decay times are empty.
